item.title: Ubuntu 26.04 Ends 46 Years of Silent sudo Passwords
item.description:
📝 04 Breaks 46 Years of sudo Tradition Ubuntu & Open Source Ubuntu 26. Canonical shipped sudo-rs as the default sudo implementation beginning with Ubuntu 25. Canonical cherry-picked that patch into Ubuntu 26.
